summary: On paper Indianapolis has the edge (Indianapolis' defense ranks 21st in EPA per dropback, +0.06 allowed). Under center, Daniel Jones ranks 19th of 23 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Tyler Warren averages 3.8 yards of separation, 2nd of 42, and Tennessee's pass defense ranks 32nd. The model favors Indianapolis at 78%, mostly on rushing matchup (3.2 pts) and passing matchup (2.2 pts).
